blocks.text: put on your shoes / put your shoes on

114-darsdagi frazali fe'llar to'ldiruvchisiz edi (get up, go away). Ko'p frazali fe'llar esa **to'ldiruvchi** bilan ishlatiladi: **put on** your coat (paltongni kiy), **turn off** the light (chiroqni o'chir). O'zbekchada to'ldiruvchi doim fe'ldan **oldin** keladi: «paltongni **kiy**», «uni **kiy**». Inglizchada esa to'ldiruvchining o'rni ikki xil bo'lishi mumkin — bu uning **ot** yoki **olmosh** ekaniga bog'liq.

To'ldiruvchi **ot** bo'lsa (your shoes, the light, the radio), kichik so'z undan oldin ham, keyin ham turishi mumkin: **take off** your shoes = **take** your shoes **off**. Ikkalasi ham bir xil to'g'ri va tabiiy. Ot uzun bo'lsa (the new shoes I bought yesterday), odatda birinchi tartib qulayroq: take off the new shoes I bought yesterday.

items.text: Dilnoza **took off** her gloves and shook my hand.
items.translation: Dilnoza qo'lqopini **yechib**, men bilan qo'l berib ko'rishdi.

items.text: Bekzod **took** his jacket **off** and sat down.

blocks.text: Olmosh bo'lsa — faqat o'rtada: put it on

To'ldiruvchi **olmosh** bo'lsa (**it**, **them**, **me**, **you**, **him**, **her**, **us**), u **faqat** fe'l bilan kichik so'z o'rtasida turadi: put **it** on, turn **them** off, wake **me** up. «put on it», «turn off them», «wake up me» — **xato**. Sababi: olmosh qisqa va urg'usiz, gapning urg'usi esa kichik so'zga tushadi — put it **ON**, turn it **OFF** — shuning uchun kichik so'z oxirida qoladi.

items.text: These gloves are too small — I can't **get them on**.
items.translation: Bu qo'lqoplar juda kichik — ularni **kiya olmayapman**.

items.text: The radio's on, but nobody's listening. **Turn it off**, please.
items.translation: Radio yoniq, lekin hech kim eshitmayapti. Iltimos, uni **o'chiring**.

items.text: Don't **wake him up** — he worked all night.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «put on it», «turn off it» → put **it** on, turn **it** off (olmosh — o'rtada!). «I **wore** my coat and went out» → I **put on** my coat: **put on** — kiyish harakati, **wear** — kiyib yurish holati (She's **wearing** a red dress). O'zbekcha «kiymoq» ikkalasini ham bildiradi. «**Open** the light / the TV» → **turn on** / **switch on**; «**close** the TV» → **turn off** (o'zbekcha «chiroqni och / yop» dan so'zma-so'z tarjima — inglizchada xato).

rows: put on a coat / take off your shoes
qaytarib bermoq / olib kelmoq / olib bormoq

blocks.text: Ba'zi frazali fe'llar ham to'ldiruvchili, ham to'ldiruvchisiz ishlatiladi, ma'nosi esa biroz o'zgaradi: I **woke up** (uyg'ondim, 114-dars) ↔ I **woke** the baby **up** (chaqaloqni uyg'otdim); The plane **took off** (ko'tarildi) ↔ **Take off** your coat (yech); I **gave up** (taslim bo'ldim) ↔ He **gave up** smoking (chekishni tashladi).

items.text: I **woke up** at five because the neighbours' dog **woke** me **up**.
items.translation: Beshda **uyg'onib ketdim**, chunki qo'shnilarning iti meni **uyg'otib yubordi**.

items.text: My father **gave up** smoking ten years ago.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: **it** / **them** / **me** / **him** / **her** — doim o'rtada: put **it** on, take **them** off, wake **me** up. Ot bo'lsa — ikki joyda ham bo'ladi. Fe'llarni juftlikda yodlang: put on ↔ take off, turn on ↔ turn off, pick up ↔ put down.

Bog'lanish: to'ldiruvchisiz frazali fe'llar (get up, go away) → 114-dars; olmosh o'rni: give it **to me** → 96-dars; to'liq ro'yxat: frazali fe'l + to'ldiruvchi (put out a fire, give up your job) → 122-dars (ilova).

examples.title: **put on** / **take off**: clothes
examples.description: Kiyim: **put on** — kiymoq (harakat), **take off** — yechmoq. Ot bilan ikki tartib ham to'g'ri: put on your coat = put your coat on. Ko'zoynak — «taqmoq», pardoz — «pardoz qilmoq».

sentences.text: It's cold outside — **put on** your warm jacket.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida sovuq — issiq kurtkangni **kiyib ol**.

sentences.text: Please **take off** your shoes before you come in.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ichkariga kirishdan oldin poyabzalingizni **yeching**.

sentences.text: Aziz **put** his best suit **on** for the interview.
sentences.translation: Aziz suhbatga eng yaxshi kostyumini **kiydi**.

sentences.text: Madina **took off** her coat and hung it in the hall.
sentences.translation: Madina paltosini **yechib**, dahlizga ilib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Why don't you **take** your jacket **off**? It's very warm in here.
sentences.translation: Kurtkangni **yechib qo'ysang**-chi? Bu yer juda issiq.

sentences.text: I **put on** my glasses, but I still couldn't read the small print.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni **taqdim**, lekin baribir mayda yozuvni o'qiy olmadim.

sentences.text: The children **put** their boots **on** and ran out into the snow.
sentences.translation: Bolalar etiklarini **kiyib**, qorga yugurib chiqishdi.

sentences.text: You should **take off** your sunglasses when you talk to someone.
sentences.translation: Kimdir bilan gaplashganda quyosh ko'zoynagingni **olib qo'yishing** kerak.

sentences.text: Emma **is putting on** her make-up, so she'll be ready in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Emma **pardoz qilyapti**, o'n daqiqada tayyor bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Sarah **took** her ring **off** before she washed the dishes.
sentences.translation: Sara idish yuvishdan oldin uzugini **yechib qo'ydi**.

examples.title: **turn on** / **off**, **switch on** / **off**
examples.description: Elektr asboblar: **turn on** / **switch on** — yoqmoq, **turn off** / **switch off** — o'chirmoq. O'zbekcha «chiroqni och / yop» ni «open / close» deb tarjima qilmang.

sentences.text: It's getting dark — can you **turn on** the light?
sentences.translation: Qorong'i tushyapti — chiroqni **yoqib** yuborasanmi?

sentences.text: Please **turn off** your phones during the lesson.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, dars paytida telefonlaringizni **o'chiring**.

sentences.text: Dad always **turns** the TV **on** when he gets home.
sentences.translation: Dadam uyga kelishi bilan televizorni **yoqadi**.

sentences.text: Did you **switch off** the oven before we left?
sentences.translation: Chiqishdan oldin duxovkani **o'chirdingmi**?

sentences.text: Don't **turn** the heating **on** yet — it isn't cold.
sentences.translation: Isitishni hali **yoqma** — sovuq emas.

sentences.text: I **switched** my laptop **off** and went to bed.
sentences.translation: Noutbukimni **o'chirib**, uxlagani yotdim.

sentences.text: Bekzod **turned on** the radio to listen to the news.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangiliklarni eshitish uchun radioni **yoqdi**.

sentences.text: Remember to **switch off** the lights when you leave the office.
sentences.translation: Ofisdan chiqayotganda chiroqlarni **o'chirishni** unutmang.

sentences.text: Who **turned** the air conditioner **off**? It's so hot in here!
sentences.translation: Konditsionerni kim **o'chirdi**? Bu yer juda issiq-ku!

sentences.text: My grandmother doesn't know how to **turn on** the new washing machine.
sentences.translation: Buvim yangi kir yuvish mashinasini qanday **yoqishni** bilmaydi.

examples.title: Pronoun in the middle: **put it on**, **take them off**
examples.description: Olmosh (it, them, me, him, her) — faqat fe'l bilan kichik so'z o'rtasida: pick **it** up, throw **them** away. «pick up it» — xato.

sentences.text: Your coat is on the floor. **Pick it up**, please.
sentences.translation: Paltong yerda yotibdi. Iltimos, uni **ko'tarib ol**.

sentences.text: These shoes look nice. Can I **try them on**?
sentences.translation: Bu tufli chiroyli ekan. **Kiyib ko'rsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Where's the light switch? I can't **turn it on**.
sentences.translation: Chiroqning tugmasi qayerda? Uni **yoqa olmayapman**.

sentences.text: I don't need these old magazines. Let's **throw them away**.
sentences.translation: Bu eski jurnallar menga kerak emas. Ularni **tashlab yuboraylik**.

sentences.text: Is the TV still on? — Yes, I forgot to **turn it off**.
sentences.translation: Televizor hali ham yoniqmi? — Ha, **o'chirishni** unutibman.

sentences.text: Aziz lent me his camera, and I have to **give it back** tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Aziz menga fotoapparatini berib turdi, ertaga uni **qaytarib berishim** kerak.

sentences.text: Here's your jacket. Why don't you **put it on**?
sentences.translation: Mana kurtkang. Uni **kiyib olsang**-chi?

sentences.text: Those boots are dirty — **take them off** at the door!
sentences.translation: U etiklar iflos — ularni eshik oldida **yech**!

sentences.text: If you don't understand a word, **look it up** in the dictionary.
sentences.translation: Biror so'zni tushunmasangiz, uni lug'atdan **qarab ko'ring**.

sentences.text: The baby is asleep. Please don't **wake her up**!
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq uxlayapti. Iltimos, uni **uyg'otib yubormang**!

examples.title: pick up, put down, throw away, put away
examples.description: Uy-ro'zg'or narsalari: **pick up** — ko'tarmoq, olmoq (do'kondan ham), **put down** — qo'ymoq, **throw away** — tashlab yubormoq, **put away** — yig'ishtirmoq, **put back** — joyiga qo'ymoq.

sentences.text: Can you **pick up** that paper from the floor?
sentences.translation: Anavi qog'ozni yerdan **olib** bera olasanmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod **put down** his bag and sat on the sofa.
sentences.translation: Bekzod sumkasini **qo'yib**, divanga o'tirdi.

sentences.text: Don't **throw away** those boxes — we can use them for the move.
sentences.translation: U qutilarni **tashlab yuborma** — ko'chishda ishlatamiz.

sentences.text: **Put** your toys **away**, kids — it's dinner time!
sentences.translation: Bolalar, o'yinchoqlaringizni **yig'ishtiringlar** — kechki ovqat vaqti bo'ldi!

sentences.text: My mum never **throws** anything **away**.
sentences.translation: Onam hech qachon hech narsani **tashlab yubormaydi**.

sentences.text: Please **put** the milk **back** in the fridge when you've finished.
sentences.translation: Ishlatib bo'lgach, sutni muzlatgichga **qaytarib qo'y**, iltimos.

sentences.text: She **picked** the baby **up** and gave him a kiss.
sentences.translation: U chaqaloqni **ko'tarib**, o'pib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: After lunch Dilnoza **put** the plates **away** in the cupboard.
sentences.translation: Tushlikdan keyin Dilnoza likopchalarni javonga **yig'ishtirib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: I **picked up** some bread on my way home.
sentences.translation: Uyga qaytayotib non **olib keldim**.

sentences.text: Why did you **throw away** the receipt? Now we can't return the shirt.
sentences.translation: Chekni nega **tashlab yubording**? Endi ko'ylakni qaytara olmaymiz.

examples.title: Giving back: give back, bring back, take back
examples.description: Qaytarish: **give back** — qaytarib bermoq, **bring back** — qaytarib olib kelmoq, **take back** — (do'konga) qaytarib olib bormoq, **pay back** — qarzni qaytarmoq, **call back** — qayta qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

sentences.text: Can I borrow your pen? I'll **give** it **back** in a minute.
sentences.translation: Ruchkangni olib tursam bo'ladimi? Hozir **qaytarib beraman**.

sentences.text: Please **bring back** the books by Friday.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, kitoblarni jumagacha **qaytarib olib keling**.

sentences.text: These trousers are too short — I'm going to **take** them **back** to the shop.
sentences.translation: Bu shim juda kalta — uni do'konga **qaytarib olib boraman**.

sentences.text: Madina lent her brother some money, but he never **paid** her **back**.
sentences.translation: Madina akasiga qarz berdi, lekin u hech qachon **qaytarib bermadi**.

sentences.text: Mr Brown isn't here at the moment. Can he **call** you **back** later?
sentences.translation: Janob Braun hozir yo'q. U sizga keyinroq **qayta qo'ng'iroq qilsa** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Did James **give** your laptop **back**?
sentences.translation: Jeyms noutbukingni **qaytarib berdimi**?

sentences.text: I'll **pay** you **back** when I get my salary on Monday.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni maosh olganimda **qarzimni qaytaraman**.

sentences.text: Could you **bring** me **back** some chocolate from Switzerland?
sentences.translation: Shveytsariyadan menga shokolad **olib kela** olasizmi?

sentences.text: The shop **took back** the broken kettle and gave us a new one.
sentences.translation: Do'kon singan choynakni **qaytarib oldi** va bizga yangisini berdi.

sentences.text: When you've finished with my bike, **put** it **back** in the garage.
sentences.translation: Velosipedimdan foydalanib bo'lgach, uni garajga **qaytarib qo'y**.

examples.title: Forms, shops and words: fill in, try on, look up
examples.description: **fill in** — (anketani) to'ldirmoq, **try on** — kiyib ko'rmoq, **write down** — yozib olmoq, **look up** — (lug'atdan, internetdan) qidirib topmoq, **find out** — bilib olmoq, **turn down** — rad etmoq.

sentences.text: Please **fill in** this form and sign it at the bottom.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ushbu anketani **to'ldiring** va pastiga imzo qo'ying.

sentences.text: Can I **try on** this dress in a smaller size?
sentences.translation: Bu ko'ylakning kichikroq o'lchamini **kiyib ko'rsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: **Write down** my phone number before you forget it.
sentences.translation: Esingdan chiqmasidan oldin telefon raqamimni **yozib ol**.

sentences.text: I didn't know the word, so I **looked** it **up** online.
sentences.translation: Bu so'zni bilmasdim, shuning uchun internetdan **qidirib topdim**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **tried on** five pairs of shoes but didn't buy any.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza besh juft tuflini **kiyib ko'rdi**, lekin birortasini ham olmadi.

sentences.text: Could you **find out** what time the museum opens?
sentences.translation: Muzey soat nechada ochilishini **bilib bera** olasizmi?

sentences.text: The teacher asked us to **write** the new words **down** in our notebooks.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi yangi so'zlarni daftarimizga **yozib olishimizni** aytdi.

sentences.text: Tom **filled in** the application form and sent it to the university.
sentences.translation: Tom ariza shaklini **to'ldirib**, universitetga jo'natdi.

sentences.text: Aziz was offered a job in London, but he **turned** it **down**.
sentences.translation: Azizga Londondan ish taklif qilishdi, lekin u **rad etdi**.

sentences.text: Don't **look up** every word — try to guess the meaning first.
sentences.translation: Har bir so'zni lug'atdan **qidirmang** — avval ma'nosini taxmin qilib ko'ring.

examples.title: People and sounds: wake me up, turn it down
examples.description: Odam va ovoz: **wake up** — uyg'otmoq, **turn up** / **down** — balandlatmoq / pasaytirmoq, **pick up** — (mashinada) olib ketmoq, **drop off** — tashlab o'tmoq, **cheer up** — ko'nglini ko'tarmoq, **let down** — umidini puchga chiqarmoq.

sentences.text: Could you **wake** me **up** at six tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Ertaga meni soat oltida **uyg'otib qo'ya** olasizmi?

sentences.text: The music is too loud — **turn** it **down**, please.
sentences.translation: Musiqa juda baland — iltimos, **pasaytir**.

sentences.text: I can't hear the radio. Can you **turn** it **up** a bit?
sentences.translation: Radio eshitilmayapti. Biroz **balandlatib** qo'yasanmi?

sentences.text: My father **picked** me **up** from the airport at midnight.
sentences.translation: Dadam meni yarim tunda aeroportdan **olib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz is very sad today. Let's **cheer** him **up**.
sentences.translation: Aziz bugun juda xafa. Uning **ko'nglini ko'taraylik**.

sentences.text: Someone's at the door — can you **let** them **in**?
sentences.translation: Eshik oldida kimdir bor — **ichkariga kiritib yuborasanmi**?

sentences.text: Our guide **showed** us **round** the old city of Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz bizga Buxoroning eski shahrini **aylantirib ko'rsatdi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, I'll **drop** you **off** at the station on my way to work.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olma, ishga ketayotib seni vokzalga **tashlab o'taman**.

sentences.text: The noise from the street **woke** the whole family **up**.
sentences.translation: Ko'chadagi shovqin butun oilani **uyg'otib yubordi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **let** us **down** — she promised to come, but she didn't.
sentences.translation: Sara bizni **umidsiz qoldirdi** — kelishga va'da bergandi, lekin kelmadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: in a clothes shop
examples.description: Kiyim do'konida: **try on**, **do up**, **take off**, **put on**, **fill in**, **write down**, **bring back**, **keep on**.

sentences.text: — Excuse me, can I **try on** this jacket?
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, bu kurtkani **kiyib ko'rsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: — Of course. You can **put** your bag **down** here while you try it.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Kiyib ko'rguningizcha sumkangizni shu yerga **qo'yib turishingiz** mumkin.

sentences.text: — Thanks. Hmm, it's too small — I can't **do** it **up**.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Hmm, kichkina ekan — tugmalarini **qadab** bo'lmayapti.

sentences.text: — Here's a bigger size. **Put** it **on** and look in the mirror.
sentences.translation: — Mana kattaroq o'lchami. **Kiyib**, ko'zguga qarang.

sentences.text: — This one fits perfectly! I don't want to **take** it **off**!
sentences.translation: — Bu juda mos keldi! **Yechgim** kelmayapti!

sentences.text: — Then could you **fill in** this short form for our discount card?
sentences.translation: — Unda chegirma kartamiz uchun shu qisqa anketani **to'ldirib bera** olasizmi?

sentences.text: — Sure. Can I **write down** my email instead of my phone number?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Telefon raqamim o'rniga elektron pochtamni **yozsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: — Of course. And if you change your mind, you can **bring** it **back** within 14 days.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Fikringiz o'zgarsa, 14 kun ichida **qaytarib olib kelishingiz** mumkin.

sentences.text: — Great. Actually, I'll **keep** it **on** — it's cold outside.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Aslida, **kiyib ketaman** — tashqarida sovuq.

sentences.text: — No problem. Let me **cut** the label **off** for you.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Yorlig'ini **kesib beraman**.
